integrity: Independent algebraic elimination from the two published reaction rates yields the exact quadratic and a root-to-equilibrium bijection on the admissible interval. Exact rational arithmetic verifies the counterexample; symbolic checks replay the general coefficient formulas, and comparison with the source’s own numerical baseline is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Only spatially homogeneous strictly positive equilibria of the published kinetic system (1.1) are classified by this reduction.
No stability, basin, Turing, Hopf, or nonconstant spatial steady-state conclusions follow automatically.
The paper’s numerical coexistence baseline agrees approximately with the correct reduction; no invalidity of its simulations is asserted.
title: Correct coexistence polynomial for a memory-based prey-taxis predator–prey model
